defects_found.description: Claims estimates are pooled across haiku and sonnet judges into one sample with bootstrap over pooled judgments. The analysis code and results report haiku and sonnet separately (results.json, results_sonnet.json, results_h3.json); no pooled sample exists.

Stated as the single CLI version for all calls, but the C3 preregistration says C3 ran on 2.1.318 (S1 and C2 ran on 2.1.317; CLI updated in between). The version claim is wrong for the headline C3 data.

Says C3 drew on 'six monthly arXiv-derived sets from December 2025 to May 2026'. The locked C3 pools contain seven arxivmath sets (1225, 0126, 0226, 0327... i.e. 1225,0126,0226,0326,0426,0526 and 0626), including June 2026.

Claims C3 used only problems never shown to a subject, yet its pools come from smt_2025, cmimc_2025, brumo_2025, apex_2025, hmmt_nov_2025 and arxivmath-0626, which the paper lists as the screen splits; exclusion was by problem and the duplicates file shows five C3 problems duplicate earlier-used ones. 'Never shown' and the clean split description are not supported.
Count does not match artifacts: exps/screens holds s1, s2/s10, s3, s4, s5, s8, s9 (eight distinct screens s1,s2,s3,s4,s5,s8,s9,s10) plus calibration.

defects_found.location: Results H3 and Conclusion 'verification by claude-sonnet-5-5 removed none of the inflation'; 'the one the other model is most likely to pass'
defects_found.description: H3 was inconclusive (d=+0.02, CI [-0.04,+0.07], p=0.29), which does not show that cross-model verification removes none. Sonnet-judge arm gave p=0.049 for a same-model excess. Acceptance of the pick by sonnet (0.16) vs haiku (0.14) is aggregate over all 225 pools, not 'most likely to pass' versus the other candidates; no such cross-model contrast was computed.

Attributes detailed findings (models accept individual incorrect options verified alone; relates isolated verification to choice; still choose when correct replaced and no-answer option offered) to Wang et al. The evidence file records only a search snippet and a one-sentence summary (least incorrect option; accuracy persists when correct option removed); pages were blocked, so the detailed claims and the 'closest prior result' framing are unsupported.

defects_found.location: Abstract/Results 'Holm-confirmed' and Method 'one Holm family' vs sonnet
defects_found.description: Sonnet replication H1u Holm p=0.012 is described as 'the same two confirmed effects', yet sonnet's effect (d=+0.13) is about half of haiku's and its strata are defined by haiku, not sonnet competence; 'beyond its competence' framing for sonnet is not measured (sonnet solvability not measured).
